nodes.name: streaming_events.rs
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw Responses API SSE event JSON into a structured ResponsesStreamOutput enum, tracking pending tool calls across output_item/function_call_arguments events so streaming consumers get a uniform delta stream.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Wire-format request/response structs for the OpenAI Responses API (ResponsesRequest, output items, usage, error) plus JSON-schema strictness enforcement helpers and ChatGPT id_token account-id extraction.

nodes.name: safe_truncate.rs
nodes.summary: Thin provider-facing re-export of the crate-wide UTF-8-safe string truncation helper, kept for backward-compatible call sites under `providers::safe_truncate`.

nodes.name: thinking_mode.rs
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for parsing ORG2's model-variant reasoning suffixes (e.g. `-high`, `-thinking-xhigh`) back into a structured reasoning level and base model id, classifying each model family's ThinkingMode, and translating (mode, level) into each provider's wire-specific thinking parameters (Anthropic effort/budget, OpenAI reasoning_effort, Zhipu toggle).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses version-aware compiled regexes (ported from Cherry Studio) to distinguish adaptive-thinking Claude model generations from legacy budget-token generations.

nodes.name: traits.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core LLMProvider async trait and its associated response/streaming/error types (LLMResponse, StreamDelta, ProviderStreamEvent, ProviderError, ToolCallRequest) that every provider backend in the crate implements, giving the agent loop a uniform interface across all LLM providers.

nodes.name: wire_sanitize.rs
nodes.summary: Sanitizes outgoing message payloads for OpenAI-compatible wire formats: strips cache-scope metadata, coalesces multiple system/developer messages into one leading system message (required by vLLM-style endpoints), and flattens rich content blocks to plain text for providers that reject block arrays.

nodes.name: ingest
nodes.summary: Ingests a single parsed Responses API SSE event, updating pending tool-call state and returning the corresponding ResponsesStreamOutput variant (text delta, reasoning delta, tool call lifecycle event, completion, or error).

nodes.name: take_pending_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Drains and returns any tool calls still pending completion, used when the stream ends before a tool call's `.done` event fires.

nodes.name: ingest_output_item
nodes.summary: Handles an `output_item.added`/`.done` event, registering or finalizing the corresponding message or function-call item in the normalizer's tracking maps.

nodes.name: take_tool_call
nodes.summary: Removes and returns the pending tool call state for a completed call id.

nodes.name: from_wire
nodes.summary: Maps a raw Responses API SSE `type` string into the internal ResponseStreamEventKind enum.

nodes.name: bounded_event_sample
nodes.summary: Produces a length-bounded debug sample string of an SSE event for logging without flooding logs with large payloads.

nodes.name: ResponsesStreamOutput
nodes.summary: Enum of normalized stream outputs the Responses SSE normalizer can produce: block boundaries, text/reasoning deltas, tool-call lifecycle events, completion, error, and unknown frames.

nodes.name: ResponsesStreamNormalizer
nodes.summary: Stateful normalizer that ingests raw Responses API SSE events and emits a uniform ResponsesStreamOutput stream, tracking pending tool calls and item/call id mappings across events.

nodes.name: ResponseStreamEventKind
nodes.summary: Enum classifying a raw Responses API SSE event's wire `type` string into a small set of internally handled kinds.

nodes.name: display_message
nodes.summary: Returns the best available human-readable message for a ResponsesError, for display or logging.

nodes.name: into_provider_error
nodes.summary: Converts a ResponsesError into the crate's internal ProviderError enum, classifying it (auth, rate-limit, etc.) in the process.

nodes.name: classify_responses_error_message
nodes.summary: Classifies a Responses API error message string into a coarse error category used to select the right ProviderError variant.

nodes.name: enforce_strict_schema
nodes.summary: Recursively rewrites a JSON schema to satisfy the Responses API's strict-mode requirements (e.g. `additionalProperties: false`, all properties required).

nodes.name: make_schema_nullable
nodes.summary: Recursively rewrites a JSON schema so its properties accept null, used when downgrading a strict schema to accept optional fields.

nodes.name: extract_account_id_from_id_token
nodes.summary: Extracts the ChatGPT account id claim from a decoded OAuth id_token, used by the Codex native backend to scope requests to the correct account.

nodes.name: ResponsesRequest
nodes.summary: Wire-format request body struct for the OpenAI Responses API: model, input items, instructions, tools, tool_choice, max_output_tokens, temperature, reasoning, store, and stream flags.

nodes.name: ResponsesError
nodes.summary: Wire-format struct for a Responses API error object (message, code, error_type, param) with helpers to produce a display message and classify it as an auth error or ProviderError.

nodes.name: StreamEvent
nodes.summary: Wire-format struct for a single raw Responses API SSE event, carrying whichever subset of type/response/code/message/param/error/delta/call_id/item_id/item fields that event kind populates.

nodes.name: from_token
nodes.summary: Parses a reasoning-level suffix token (e.g. 'high', 'xhigh') into the corresponding ReasoningLevel variant.

nodes.name: parse_model_variant
nodes.summary: Parses ORG2's model-variant suffix encoding (e.g. `glm-5.2-high`, `claude-opus-4-7-thinking-xhigh`) off of a model id, returning the structured ParsedVariant with base model id, reasoning level, thinking flag, and fast-model flag.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.summary: Returns the ordinal rank of a ReasoningLevel used for comparing/escalating reasoning levels.

nodes.name: suffix_token
nodes.summary: Returns the canonical suffix token string for a ReasoningLevel, the inverse of from_token.

nodes.name: detect_reasoning_trigger
nodes.summary: Scans free-form text for phrases that imply the user wants heightened reasoning, used to auto-escalate the reasoning level for a turn.

nodes.name: escalate_model_reasoning
nodes.summary: Returns a model id with its reasoning level escalated to at least the given minimum level, preserving the base model.

nodes.name: opus47_or_newer_regex
nodes.summary: Returns the lazily-compiled regex matching Claude Opus 4.7-and-newer model id patterns.

nodes.name: is_claude_opus_47_or_newer
nodes.summary: Reports whether a base model id matches the Claude Opus 4.7-or-newer / Fable-5 / Mythos adaptive-thinking generation.

nodes.name: resolve_thinking_mode
nodes.summary: Classifies a base model id and provider name into the ThinkingMode (adaptive, legacy-budget, effort, toggle, or none) that determines which wire parameter shape to send for reasoning control.

nodes.name: anthropic_effort
nodes.summary: Maps a ThinkingMode/ReasoningLevel pair to the Anthropic adaptive-effort wire parameter string.

nodes.name: anthropic_thinking_param
nodes.summary: Builds the Anthropic `thinking` request parameter JSON (effort or budget_tokens shape) for a given mode, level, and max_tokens.

nodes.name: anthropic_legacy_budget
nodes.summary: Computes the legacy `budget_tokens` value for pre-adaptive Claude models given a reasoning level and max_tokens.

nodes.name: anthropic_max_tokens_floor
nodes.summary: Ensures max_tokens is raised to a minimum floor sufficient to accommodate the requested thinking budget for Anthropic models.

nodes.name: resolve_openai_compat_thinking
nodes.summary: Resolves the OpenAiCompatThinking wire parameters (reasoning_effort or thinking toggle) for a resolved model and provider name on the OpenAI-compatible wire.

nodes.name: ReasoningLevel
nodes.summary: Enum of reasoning intensity levels (None through Ultracode) that ORG2 encodes as model-id suffixes, ordered for comparison via rank().

nodes.name: ThinkingMode
nodes.summary: Enum classifying a model's reasoning-control shape (adaptive effort, Anthropic 4.6 budget, legacy budget, OpenAI effort, or Zhipu toggle), the central dispatch value thinking_mode.rs resolves before translating a reasoning level into wire parameters.

nodes.name: ParsedVariant
nodes.summary: Struct holding the result of parsing a model-variant suffix: base model id, reasoning level, whether thinking is enabled, and whether it's the fast-model variant.

nodes.name: primary_text
nodes.summary: Returns the primary visible text content of an LLMResponse, excluding reasoning content.

nodes.name: iter_blocks
nodes.summary: Returns an iterator over an LLMResponse's ordered AssistantBlocks (text, reasoning, tool call).

nodes.name: text
nodes.summary: Convenience constructor building a StreamDelta that carries only visible text content, with no reasoning, tool-call delta, or finish reason set.

nodes.name: into_provider_stream_event
nodes.summary: Converts a generic StreamDelta into the crate's ProviderStreamEvent representation for downstream consumers.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Implements Display for ProviderError, formatting each error variant into a human-readable message.

nodes.name: LLMResponse
nodes.summary: The unified response shape every provider maps its native response into: aggregate content, tool calls, finish reason, usage, reasoning content, and ordered content blocks.

nodes.name: ProviderStreamEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of normalized streaming lifecycle events (message delta, thinking delta, tool-call delta/start/ready, flush segment, complete, unknown frame) consumed by the turn executor.

nodes.name: SideQueryExecution
nodes.summary: Enum indicating whether a provider-issued side query (e.g. title generation) should reuse the shared session or run in an isolated session, with helper predicates for each case.

nodes.name: LLMProvider
nodes.summary: The core async trait every LLM backend implements: chat, chat_streaming, chat_with_options, default_model, provider_name, set_session_context, begin_logical_turn, side_query_execution — giving the agent loop a single uniform interface across all providers.

nodes.name: ProviderError
nodes.summary: Enum of all error conditions a provider can surface (request failure, parse error, auth error, usage limit, rate limited, overloaded, model not found, context too long, media too large, cancelled, other), implementing Display for uniform error messages.

nodes.name: StreamErrorKind
nodes.summary: Enum classifying streaming failures into idle-timeout, overloaded, provider-error, connection-error, or unknown, used by ReliableProvider to decide retry behavior.

nodes.name: StreamDelta
nodes.summary: The unified streaming delta shape every provider emits per SSE chunk: content, reasoning, tool-call delta, finish reason, and usage.

nodes.name: ProviderConfig
nodes.summary: Struct carrying the credentials and connection settings (api_key, api_base, extra_headers, is_azure) needed to construct any provider client.

nodes.name: strip_tool_schema_cache_scopes
nodes.summary: Strips internal prompt-cache scope metadata from a tool schema array before it's sent over the wire, since providers don't understand this internal-only field.

nodes.name: coalesce_system_messages_to_front
nodes.summary: Merges every system/developer message in the array into a single leading system message at index 0, required by vLLM-style endpoints that reject non-leading system messages.

nodes.name: sanitize_deepseek_messages
nodes.summary: Applies DeepSeek-specific message wire adjustments not needed by other OpenAI-compatible providers.

nodes.name: sanitize_message
nodes.summary: Applies cache-metadata stripping and content normalization to a single outgoing message.

nodes.name: flatten_text_content
nodes.summary: Flattens a message's rich content-block array down to a single plain-text string, for providers that reject block-array content.

nodes.name: flatten_text_content_with_image_placeholders
nodes.summary: Flattens rich content to plain text like flatten_text_content, but replaces image blocks with a textual placeholder instead of dropping them silently.

nodes.name: strip_content_cache_metadata
nodes.summary: Removes internal prompt-cache scope metadata from a message's content blocks before sending it over the wire.
